rows.label: qev230201_MSG0001
rows.name:
Thanks for your patronage! Welcome to
the Shining Erudition Hall! Thanks for
taking our exchange request![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev230201_MSG0002
rows.name:
At the bronze member rate... Give
Mee-mee 10,000 gm of Miranium, and I'll
give you 20,000 G![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev230201_MSG0003
rows.name:
Now, hand it over, please! Let's cash in
and be happy![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev230201_SEL0021
rows.name: Don't hand it over just yet.

rows.label: qev230201_MSG0004
rows.name:
I've received it! Here's 20,000 G, a
gift for you! We look forward to seeing
you again![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev230201_MSG0005
rows.name:
Oh dear! Until next time, then! Bring
lots of Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev230201_MSG0006
rows.name:
[ST:wide ]—Hey, you! You don't have any Miranium!
Please bring the full 10,000 gm![ST:wait ]
